name: Heartwood Warden
journal_prompt: It has not moved since you sat down. You are no longer certain it is a tree.
notes: A maya-born shaped from heartwood, leaf-mould, spore and sap rather than from mud or fire. Slower than either, and the only one of the three that keeps growing after it is made -- an old warden is indistinguishable from the wood it stands in until it turns its head. Sentient, like the rest of the maya-born: a person made of forest, not an animal shaped like one.
placement_note: Exists in canon and does not spawn. Making it an encounter would add it to the forest and wetland pools, which changes what a player meets on tiles they have already walked -- a game decision rather than a lore one. The Asura-Tainted Gargoyle is filed the same way. Promote it deliberately when the spawn change is wanted.
